name: Walter Jenkins
household: Spouse, divorced adult children visit occasionally
psychographics: Frugality is a habit formed during youth; prefers face-to-face interaction and handwritten lists over apps.
current_solutions: Clips physical coupons from the Sunday Portland Tribune, visits the monthly senior discount day at Fred Meyer, and uses a flip phone for calls only.
frustration: Drove 15 miles to the local Walmart at 9:00 AM for the 'Early Bird' senior discount, only to find the sign was outdated and the cashier refused the discount.
decision_style: Buys in bulk only when the unit price is visibly lower; refuses to buy anything new if a working version exists at a thrift store.
voice: Formal and measured; uses complete sentences, avoids slang, and frequently says 'I suppose' or 'You know'.
